name: genos_rebase_compute_plan
description: Computes a causal rebase plan (Butterfly Effect) given an action dependency graph, an injection step, and injected writes.

graph_file.description: Path to the JSON file containing the ActionDependencyGraph.

injection_step.description: The step index at which history is modified.

injected_keys.description: List of state variable keys mutated by the injection.
